description:
Resolve an imported ERC-8004 registration by bridge DID or by
    (chain_id, token_id).

bridge_did.description: The bridge DID, did:viridis:erc8004:<chain>:<token>. Or give chain_id and token_id.
bridge_did.title: Bridge Did

chain_id.description: EVM chain id where the ERC-8004 registry lives, for example 8453 for Base.
chain_id.title: Chain Id

token_id.description: The agent's ERC-721 token id in the Identity Registry.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: resolve_agent
title: Resolve agent
